title: Hardware Interrupt
text: Trigger downstream function-call subsystems from interrupt service routine, 1 input, 1 output, {Number of events to serve} sets number of events to serve; {Simulink task priority} sets the priority of selected ISR, {Disable interrupt pre-emption} selects to disable interrupt preemption and {Enable simulation port}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of events to serve
params.values: Specify number of events to serve 1 (default) | 2 | 3 | <32

params.name: Simulink task priority
params.values: Set priority of selected ISR 50 (default) | positive integer or nonnegative integer

params.name: Disable interrupt pre-emption
params.values: Select to disable interrupt preemption off (default) | on

params.name: Enable simulation port
params.values: Enable simulation ports to block off (default) | on
